data.sub: Jasprit Bumrah Srinath ko pachhadkar bane India ke 10ve sabse safal Test bowler.

chat.say: Bumrah bhai ka koi jawab nahi hai!
Agli series mein aur records tutenge.

data.asar: Test cricket mein India ka maan fir se badh gaya hai.
data.caption:
Jasprit Bumrah ne ek aur bada record apne naam kar liya hai! 🏏

• Wellington mein shandar bowling
• Srinath ko pichhda
• Bane India ke 10ve sabse safal Test bowler
• New Zealand ki pehli paari 368 run par simti
